result.stdout:
glider 13.1.0
A semantic C#/.NET code navigation and refactoring MCP server (stdio or HTTP).
Requires .NET 10 SDK.

Usage:
  glider [--transport stdio|http] [--port <n>] [--default-timeout <duration>] [--build-host <auto|netframework|netcore>] [--msbuild-path <path>] [--solution <path>] [--workspace <path>] [--no-watch] [--no-warmup] [--verbose] [--no-telemetry]
  glider --version
  glider --help

Shared sandbox license commands:
  auth login --environment sandbox [--credential-store vault|file] [--profile-directory PATH]
  auth logout --environment sandbox [--profile-directory PATH]
  license status --environment sandbox [--json] [--profile-directory PATH]
  license refresh --environment sandbox [--profile-directory PATH]
A login uses the system browser. Both products share the OS-user profile.
The vault is the default credential store. File storage requires an explicit selection.
macOS app signatures can block shared vault access. Select file storage explicitly if this occurs.
Sandbox activation grants no production commercial rights.
Options:
  --transport <stdio|http>   Transport to use (default: stdio).
  --port <n>                 HTTP port (default: 5001).
  --default-timeout <value>  Default timeout for async tools (default: 20m). Use 0 to disable.
                             Supported units: ms, s, m (for example: 10ms, 10s, 10m).
  --build-host <value>       Roslyn build-host mode (default: auto). Valid options: auto, netframework, netcore.
  --msbuild-path <path>      Explicit MSBuild location. Point to a directory containing MSBuild.exe or MSBuild.dll,
                             or to one of those files directly.
  --solution <path>          Solution or project (.sln, .slnx, .csproj) to load automatically at startup.
                             Relative paths resolve against the launch directory; prefer absolute paths in shared configs.
  --workspace <path>         Root directory for file watching/auto-sync when --solution is used.
                             Defaults to the enclosing git reposit
